name: Yukimura Yukinojou
source:
Protagonist and the title giver of Ashita no Yukinojou (the other half, "Ashita no", is a reference to the boxing manga [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomorrow%27s_Joe]Ashita no Joe[/url]). A genius boxer who after a certain incident completely abandoned boxing. [spoiler]The aforementioned event shocked him so much that he is completely unable to hit anyone.[/spoiler]

He transferred to the second year of Kashima school, into Serina's class. He's exceedingly fit, but at the same time taciturn and unsociable toward everyone.
